Yuji Itadori.power: A high schooler with superhuman physical strength who swallowed one of Sukuna's fingers and became the vessel of the King of Curses. He fights hand to hand with Divergent Fist, where his cursed energy hits a split second after his punch, and he can land Black Flash, a strike that distorts space and amplifies cursed energy.
Yuji Itadori.look: young man with spiky pink hair with dark undercut, dark navy school uniform with red hood

Megumi Fushiguro.power: A first-year sorcerer who uses the Ten Shadows Technique, summoning shikigami from his own shadow like the Divine Dogs and the bird Nue. The strongest of them, Mahoraga, has never been tamed by anyone. His domain is called Chimera Shadow Garden.
Megumi Fushiguro.look: young man with spiky black hair, dark navy school uniform, summoning black shadow dogs

Nobara Kugisaki.power: A first-year sorcerer who fights with a hammer and cursed nails through the Straw Doll Technique. With Resonance, she strikes a straw doll and the damage lands directly on her target, even from a distance.
Nobara Kugisaki.look: young woman with short orange-brown bob hair, holding a hammer and nails

Satoru Gojo.power: The strongest sorcerer alive. Born with both the Limitless and the Six Eyes, he is surrounded by Infinity, so attacks slow down and never reach him. He fires Blue, which pulls, Red, which repels, and fuses them into Hollow Purple. His domain is Unlimited Void.
Satoru Gojo.look: tall man with spiky white hair and black blindfold or bright blue eyes, black high-collar uniform

Ryomen Sukuna.power: The King of Curses, whose power was sealed into twenty fingers. He slices everything around him with Dismantle and Cleave, and his domain, Malevolent Shrine, is drawn without a barrier, cutting everything in range.
Ryomen Sukuna.look: man with pink hair and black facial tattoo markings, four red eyes, white kimono

Kento Nanami.power: A former salaryman turned grade one sorcerer. His Ratio Technique divides any target into ten parts and creates a weak point at the seven to three line, and when he works past his set hours, Overtime makes him even stronger.
Kento Nanami.look: man with neat blond hair, tinted goggles, beige suit and patterned tie, blade wrapped in cloth

Aoi Todo.power: A grade one sorcerer with brutal physical strength. His technique, Boogie Woogie, swaps the positions of anything with cursed energy the instant he claps his hands.
Aoi Todo.look: huge muscular man with dark hair tied up, scar on face, white tank top

Mahito.power: A special grade curse born from human hatred of each other. His Idle Transfiguration reshapes the soul by touch, twisting the body along with it, and his domain is Self-Embodiment of Perfection.
Mahito.look: patchwork grey-blue skinned man with stitched scars and long blue-grey hair

Jogo.power: A special grade curse born from humanity's fear of the earth and volcanoes. He commands fire and magma, and his domain is Coffin of the Iron Mountain.
Jogo.look: short curse with a volcano-shaped head and one eye, white robe, lava and fire

Hanami.power: A special grade curse born from humanity's fear of the forests. It controls plants and roots and is extremely durable.
Hanami.look: tall curse with wooden horn-like eyes, white cloth, plants and flowers

Choso.power: The eldest of the Death Painting Wombs, part human and part curse. He uses Blood Manipulation, compressing his own blood into Piercing Blood, a shot faster than sound.
Choso.look: man with black hair in two spiky tufts, dark line across nose, blood manipulation

Toji Fushiguro.power: The Sorcerer Killer. Heavenly Restriction left him with zero cursed energy but a monstrous body and senses. He hunts sorcerers with cursed tools like the Inverted Spear of Heaven, which cancels techniques it touches.
Toji Fushiguro.look: muscular man with short black hair, scar on lip, tight black shirt, holding a weapon

Suguru Geto.power: A special grade sorcerer and Gojo's former best friend. His Cursed Spirit Manipulation lets him absorb defeated curses and command them, and he can fuse them into Maximum Uzumaki.
Suguru Geto.look: man with long black hair in a half bun, stretched earlobes, black monk robes

Yuta Okkotsu.power: A special grade sorcerer bound to the cursed spirit Rika. With Rika he can copy other sorcerers' techniques, and he has massive reserves of cursed energy.
Yuta Okkotsu.look: young man with messy black hair and tired eyes, white uniform, katana, huge curse Rika

Maki Zenin.power: A sorcerer born with Heavenly Restriction, so she has almost no cursed energy but superhuman strength. She fights with cursed tools like spears and swords.
Maki Zenin.look: young woman with green hair in ponytail and glasses or scarred face, wielding a polearm

Toge Inumaki.power: A sorcerer of the Inumaki clan with Cursed Speech. Whatever he commands out loud happens, so in daily life he speaks only in rice ball ingredients.
Toge Inumaki.look: young man with light grey hair, high collar covering mouth

Kinji Hakari.power: A third-year sorcerer whose domain, Idle Death Gamble, works like a pachinko machine. When he hits the jackpot, he gets endless cursed energy and heals from almost any wound for over four minutes.
Kinji Hakari.look: man with blond quiff hair, green jacket, pachinko and jackpot lights

Hiromi Higuruma.power: A former lawyer whose domain, Deadly Sentencing, puts opponents on trial before the shikigami Judgeman. A guilty verdict can confiscate their technique, and the harshest gives him the Executioner's Sword, which kills in one cut.
Hiromi Higuruma.look: man with messy black hair and stubble, lawyer badge, giant gavel

Naoya Zenin.power: A Zenin clan sorcerer with Projection Sorcery. He splits one second into twenty-four frames and moves at insane speed, freezing anyone who breaks his rules.
Naoya Zenin.look: man with dyed blond hair with dark roots, multiple ear piercings, dark kimono, moving at blur speed

Tanjiro Kamado.power: A demon slayer with an incredible sense of smell who uses Water Breathing. He also inherited Hinokami Kagura, his family's dance of the fire god, which is tied to Sun Breathing.
Tanjiro Kamado.look: boy with dark red hair, scar on forehead, hanafuda earrings, green and black checkered haori, sword with water or fire

Nezuko Kamado.power: Tanjiro's younger sister, turned into a demon, who refuses to eat humans. She can change her size and uses the Blood Demon Art Exploding Blood, which burns demons.
Nezuko Kamado.look: girl with long black hair fading to orange, bamboo muzzle, pink kimono

Zenitsu Agatsuma.power: A demon slayer who uses Thunder Breathing but only ever mastered the First Form, Thunderclap and Flash. Usually terrified, he becomes lethal when he falls asleep, striking faster than the eye can follow.
Zenitsu Agatsuma.look: boy with yellow-orange hair, yellow haori with white triangles, lightning sword slash

Inosuke Hashibira.power: A demon slayer raised by boars who wears a boar head mask. He fights with two jagged blades using Beast Breathing, a style he created himself, and his body is flexible enough to dislocate his joints.
Inosuke Hashibira.look: shirtless muscular boy wearing a boar head mask, two jagged swords

Kyojuro Rengoku.power: The Flame Hashira, one of the strongest demon slayers. He uses Flame Breathing, and his ultimate technique, Ninth Form Rengoku, carries his own name.
Kyojuro Rengoku.look: man with flaming yellow and red hair, white flame-patterned cape, fire sword attacks

Akaza.power: Upper Rank Three of the Twelve Kizuki, a demon martial artist. His Blood Demon Art, Destructive Death, launches shockwave punches, and Compass Needle lets him sense every move his opponent makes.
Akaza.look: demon with pink hair and blue line tattoos all over his body, martial arts fighting

Tengen Uzui.power: The Sound Hashira, a former shinobi who calls everything flashy. He fights with two chained cleaver blades using Sound Breathing, and his Musical Score reads an opponent's attack rhythm to find openings.
Tengen Uzui.look: tall man with white hair, jeweled headband, red eye makeup, twin cleavers with chains

Daki.power: One half of Upper Rank Six. She attacks with living obi sashes that slice like blades, and she can only be killed if her brother Gyutaro is beheaded at the same time.
Daki.look: demon woman with long black or white hair, flower hair ornaments, flowing obi sash belts

Gyutaro.power: The true strength of Upper Rank Six, sharing the rank with his sister Daki. He throws poisoned blood sickles, and the two must be beheaded at the same moment to die.
Gyutaro.look: thin hunched demon with green-black hair, black spots on his face, blood sickles

Giyu Tomioka.power: The Water Hashira, the calm swordsman who spared Tanjiro and Nezuko. He uses Water Breathing and created his own Eleventh Form, Dead Calm, which neutralizes every attack in his range.
Giyu Tomioka.look: man with long dark hair in low ponytail, split haori half red half pattern, water breathing

Shinobu Kocho.power: The Insect Hashira. Too small to behead demons, she kills them with poison made from wisteria, delivered through a needle-like sword with Insect Breathing.
Shinobu Kocho.look: small woman with butterfly hair ornament, butterfly-pattern haori, thin stinger sword

Muichiro Tokito.power: The Mist Hashira, who became a Hashira just two months after picking up a sword. He uses Mist Breathing and created his own Seventh Form, Obscuring Clouds.
Muichiro Tokito.look: young boy with long black hair fading to mint green, blank stare, mist sword

Mitsuri Kanroji.power: The Love Hashira, whose muscles are eight times denser than normal. She fights with a sword thin and flexible like a whip using Love Breathing.
Mitsuri Kanroji.look: woman with long pink and green braided hair, flexible whip sword

Rui.power: Lower Rank Five, a spider demon. His threads are sharp enough to slice through flesh and steel, and he forces other demons to act as his fake family.
Rui.look: pale demon child with white hair and red eye marks, spider threads

Enmu.power: Lower Rank One, a demon who traps his victims in dreams so he can kill them while they sleep.
Enmu.look: demon with dark hair and eyes on his hands, dream manipulation on a train

Hantengu.power: Upper Rank Four, a cowardly demon who splits into clones of his emotions, like Anger, Joy, Sorrow and Pleasure, while his real body hides.
Hantengu.look: old small demon with horns and bumps on his forehead, splitting into emotion clones

Gyokko.power: Upper Rank Five, a demon who lives in vases and calls itself an artist. It teleports between pots and summons fish creatures.
Gyokko.look: demon with eyes in place of mouth and mouth in place of eyes, vases and fish

Kokushibo.power: Upper Rank One, the strongest of the Twelve Kizuki. A former demon slayer with six eyes, he wields Moon Breathing with a sword made of his own flesh.
Kokushibo.look: samurai demon with six eyes, long black ponytail, purple kimono, moon blade

Doma.power: Upper Rank Two, a smiling cult leader demon who uses ice. His frozen blood mist destroys the lungs of anyone who breathes it.
Doma.look: demon with white-blonde hair, rainbow eyes, smiling, golden fans, ice powers

Muzan Kibutsuji.power: The first demon and the king of all demons. Every demon was created by his blood, and he is the one Tanjiro has sworn to destroy.
Muzan Kibutsuji.look: pale man with black wavy hair, red eyes, white fedora or suit, flesh whips

Sanemi Shinazugawa.power: The Wind Hashira, covered in scars. His rare blood intoxicates demons, and he slices with Wind Breathing.
Sanemi Shinazugawa.look: man with spiky white hair and many scars, open white uniform, wind sword

Gyomei Himejima.power: The Stone Hashira, considered the strongest Hashira. He is blind but fights with a spiked flail and an axe joined by a chain using Stone Breathing.
Gyomei Himejima.look: giant blind man with scar on forehead, prayer beads, flail axe and chain

Obanai Iguro.power: The Serpent Hashira, who fights alongside his white snake Kaburamaru with a twisting blade and Serpent Breathing.
Obanai Iguro.look: man with black hair, heterochromia, bandaged mouth, white snake on shoulders
